title: Job Odijk
text: Hi, my name is Job Odijk. Currently I’m a master’s student Methodology, Statistics and Data Science at Utrecht University. I am doing this master’s because of my love for data analysis and all the challanges that come with it. Before the master’s I got a BSc degree in Sociology where i founded my remained interest in societal problems. My interests specifically lie in the area of prediction. Currently, I am doing an intership at the deparment of Biostatistics & Data Science at UMC Utrecht work on prediction in the clinical context.
